### The Power of God for Salvation
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/power-god-salvation
Passage: Romans 1:16
Points:
- Paul desired to minister in Rome because its cultural prominence made it vital for spreading the gospel worldwide.
- The message of a crucified Savior and resurrection seemed foolish and laughable by worldly standards.
- Paul's personal encounter with the risen Christ removed all shame regarding this countercultural message.
- Believers must resist watering down the gospel to make it acceptable to a skeptical society.
- God's power brings salvation to all people—both Jew and Gentile—solely through faith.

### The Gospel: The Power of God
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Decision Magazine
URL: https://billygraham.org/decision-magazine/articles/the-gospel-the-power-of-god
Passage: Romans 1:16
Points:
- Christians should refuse to hide in shame and instead boldly stand for their faith in every setting.
- The gospel centers on Jesus Christ, whose incomparable life and impact transcend all human figures in history.
- God gave the gospel to rescue individual sinners from ruin, not merely to reform human society.
- The power of God both breaks the penalty of sin and continuously sustains the believer day by day.
- God designed salvation around faith so it could remain entirely by grace and open to anyone who believes.
